kultivator.guide.c18.acara.body:
The capital calendar (one big event per day): the Pill Gathering (day %% 7 == 2, 6000-9000, a five-minute alchemy contest), the Grand Auction (day %% 7 == 5), Gate Opening Day (day %% 10 == 4, sect stalls and disciple candidates), the Grand Inter-Sect Tournament (day %% 14 == 9), the Lantern Festival (full-moon nights, 13000-18000, 40 riddles at the lantern stalls) and the Sect Assembly (day %% 30 == 15).
Sometimes the war drums sound: a Beast Tide storms one gate in three waves. Hold the wall; a fallen gate is only an entity, no block changes.
Events only come alive when a player is within 256 blocks of the city centre.
kultivator.guide.c18.acara.title: Join a city event
kultivator.guide.c18.gilda.body:
Three guilds stand in the Guild District: the Alchemists (Elder Dan Chen), the Forge (Ou Ye the Younger) and the Cultivators (Lin Fei the One-Armed). Take missions from the Cultivators' Guild board; each finished mission adds badge points, and your first badge paper is stamped red at Star 1.
Higher stars open guild shop discounts, higher-ranked mission boards and extra missions; some stars need an exam at the guild counter. The hundred finest young cultivators are recorded on the Young Dragon List.
kultivator.guide.c18.gilda.title: First guild badge
kultivator.guide.c18.hukum.body:
The Yamen north of the Grand Square records crimes seen by witnesses: hurting a resident 5 points, killing a resident 20, stealing from someone's chest 4, damaging buildings 2 per 10 blocks, climbing the wall after curfew 3. Points drop by 2 a day.
10 points: Suspected (guards follow you). 25: Wanted (your face on the board, guards attack, shops and stations refuse you). 60: Most Wanted (the Guard Captain hunts you).
Settle it by paying the fine (points x 3 x (band + 1) NB) at the Yamen or to a guard, or Surrender and sit in a cell for a while. Escaping a cell adds 20 points.
kultivator.guide.c18.hukum.title: Read the Yamen board (optional)
kultivator.guide.c18.layanan.body:
The capital has about forty services. Try three different ones, for example:
Inn and eatery (rest, dishes with effects), the Temple of Heaven (incense 3 NB, Temple Blessing for 60 minutes, once a day it lowers heart demon pressure), the Healers' Hall (cures Qi Deviation), the Library (daily lecture 9000-10000), the Money House (vault, money orders, pawning), the Spirit Beast Market, the Forge, the Night Market (12500-18000).
Your Standing in this city sets the prices: Strangers pay +10 %%, Known Residents get a vault, the Honoured and City Heroes get discounts.
kultivator.guide.c18.layanan.title: Use three services
kultivator.guide.c18.lelang.body:
The Grand Auction is held in the Auction House on the 5th world day of every seven (day %% 7 == 5), from 12000 to 15000, with eight lots. Arrive before it starts, take a seat, then bid on the auction screen. You may also consign your own goods as a lot; the commission goes to the City Treasury.
Winning a lot adds +1 Standing.
kultivator.guide.c18.lelang.title: Join the Grand Auction
kultivator.guide.c18.takhta.body:
When the first player enters the capital, the city's story begins: Captain Tie Hu greets you at the gate and Judge Bao posts a notice about people gone missing in the slums. Seven chapters run over about 24 world days; if you stay out of it, each chapter still moves on by itself after its deadline.
Finish chapter 3 (The Ailing Heir): brew or find an antidote for Yan Ruyi. Your choices in the later chapters decide who takes the throne and how the city treats you.
See your chapter and running quests in /kultivasi jurnal.
kultivator.guide.c18.takhta.title: Shadow Behind the Throne
kultivator.guide.c18.teleport.body:
At a formation station the Formation Keeper sends you to places you already know: towns, other capitals, large villages, clan villages, great waystations or sect compounds that stand at least Neutral with you. The fare is ceil(2 + distance / 250) NB per person, at most 120; following disciples within 8 blocks come along (at most 4). The 3-second channel breaks if you are attacked.
Cloud Travel at the Sky Dock reaches destinations 600 blocks or more away, in daytime 1000-11000, for ceil(6 + distance / 150) NB.
kultivator.guide.c18.teleport.title: Use a teleport station
kultivator.guide.c18.tiba.body:
The first capital stands in the ring 1800-3200 blocks from the world centre when the land allows; its wall is 432 x 432 blocks, with nine districts inside and two outside. The stone Imperial Road from each of its gates leads you there, and road milestones draw the road on your map (/kultivasi peta).
The night drum sounds at 22000: the gates close and open again at 1000. Left outside? Talk to the gate guard: 2 NB (Standing at least 0), free if you are Honoured. Wanted people are refused.
The first law is written above the gate: "Within the walls, swords sleep."
kultivator.guide.c18.tiba.title: Reach the capital
kultivator.guide.c19.ikrar.body:
A village can swear loyalty to your sect through a Sect Protection Plaque on its bell post, like an ordinary vassal village. A pledged village pays tribute and every 10 days sends one gifted disciple candidate to your hall.
Clan villages are prouder: beat the Patriarch in a duel or reach clan standing 50. The clan's Young Master likes to challenge low-realm guests; the duel is a friendly one.
kultivator.guide.c19.ikrar.title: Pledge a village (optional)
kultivator.guide.c19.jalan.body:
Roads link capitals, towns, villages, sect gates and cave mouths: stone Imperial Roads, earthen Village Roads and Footpaths to the caves. Touching a stone milestone beside them draws that road and both its ends on your map (/kultivasi peta).
Along the way are Road Shrines (incense 1 NB: Road Blessing, Speed I for 3 minutes), waystations, caravanserais, raft crossings (1 NB) and bandit camps best avoided while you are still weak.
kultivator.guide.c19.jalan.title: Touch three road milestones
kultivator.guide.c19.kampung.body:
Mortal villages grow by biome: timber houses and paddies on the plains, stilt houses in the swamp, oasis houses in the desert, terraced paddies in the hills. There are hamlets, villages, market towns with a weekly market and walled clan villages.
The village square has a bell, a well and a small Earth God shrine; the Headman gives news and asks for help, the Village Healer treats light Qi Deviation. Every 12th world day (day %% 12 == 0) there is a Harvest Festival.
Every village has its own legend; read it in /kultivasi legenda.
kultivator.guide.c19.kampung.title: Visit a village
kultivator.guide.c19.kompleks.body:
Behind every NPC sect's gate now stands its compound: the outer disciples' court, the inner hall and the peak hall, terraced up the mountain. The buildings follow the alignment: Righteous white and jade, Neutral wood and gold, Demonic black and red.
The sect's stance decides your welcome: Allies and Friends may enter the inner hall, spar in a friendly bout and buy cheaply at the sect market; Neutral guests reach only the court; the Hostile are warned at the gate; at War the guards attack.
kultivator.guide.c19.kompleks.title: Visit a sect compound
kultivator.guide.c19.perbaikan.body:
When a place is damaged, its builders repair it slowly under scaffolding; blocks are only ever put back as they were. If you did the damage, a bill collector brings a Damage Bill: pay, haggle, or refuse (refusing is recorded as a crime).
You may also work alongside the builders or donate materials for help points and Standing. A place too afraid of you does not dare send a bill; it repairs itself, but far more slowly.
kultivator.guide.c19.perbaikan.title: Pay for damage or help the builders
kultivator.guide.c19.pertapa.body:
Hermit Caves hide on quiet slopes. The hermit sets three trials over several days: bring a herb 100 years old or more, meditate five minutes without a break in their room, then answer one Dao koan.
Pass, and the hermit teaches one of their Dao techniques or deepens your comprehension, then leaves to wander. The cave becomes a good meditation place you can make your Cave Abode.
kultivator.guide.c19.pertapa.title: Become a hermit's student
kultivator.guide.c19.sarang.body:
Beast Dens are guarded by an elite beast; your tamed spirit beasts grow faster fighting there, and sometimes a stray cub can be tamed.
Demonic Cultivator Lairs hide behind cliff doors that open when your realm is high enough. Defeat the Demon Elder, open the captives' cages, then escort them to the nearest village or town (+3 Standing in the destination town). The Cultivators' Guild often posts missions for lairs like these.
kultivator.guide.c19.sarang.title: Clear a lair
kultivator.guide.c19.warisan.body:
Inheritance Tombs open beneath a stele in open country. The suggested realm is written on the entry card: tier 1 Foundation, tier 2 Nascent Soul, tier 3 Dao Union. Disciples cannot come in.
The ancestor's remnant soul tells its story, then tests Heart (three illusions), Strength (guardian puppets) and Comprehension (arrange the glyph tablets). The reward comes once per player per tomb: the tomb's Dao technique jade and a treasure. An Inheritance Jade points to the nearest tomb you know.
kultivator.guide.c19.warisan.title: Heir of a tomb
kultivator.guide.chapter.18.desc: The neutral capital of the seven sects: services, guilds, the Grand Auction, Yamen law, events, the Shadow Behind the Throne story and the teleport stations.
kultivator.guide.chapter.19.desc: Villages and clan villages, sect compounds, hermit caves, inheritance tombs, lairs, milestone roads and repairing damaged places.
